business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Armored Security Personnel Transport Vehicles

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction; ISO 3166-1: CO/COL)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Napoleonic-Hispano tradition; unitary national hierarchy; principal commercial codification is Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Colombia Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA; Ley 1143 de 2007; investment chapter in force 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation; AML/CFT coordination) as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006 and Ley 1621 de 2013; Resolución UIAF 164 de 2020 arts. 2-5 (Registro de Beneficiario Final, 5% direct/indirect ownership or control threshold); Decreto 830 de 2021 (mandatory collection and reporting of Beneficiario Final data by Cámaras de Comercio via RUES); Ley 599 de 2000 Código Penal art. 323 as reformed by Ley 1762 de 2015 (money laundering predicate offense); Decreto 2535 de 1993 and Decreto 1070 de 2015 (control of arms, munitions, explosives and military material); Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, no minimum capital, private deed incorporation); Código de Comercio arts. 110-124 (commercial registration); Carta Circular Superintendencia de Sociedades 100-000002 de 2022 (SARLAFT programs); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES unified registry regime)
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (UBO data held in the private Registro de Beneficiario Final operated by the Cámaras de Comercio and transmitted to UIAF; supervisory and law enforcement access only; not searchable by the public)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence of each corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder's domicile (e.g., Secretary of State, U.S.A.; Companies House, U.K.)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the originating state; for non-Hague Party states, notarization followed by Consular Legalization at the Colombian consulate of jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport or national identity document of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or official registrar in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency / Register of Officers and Legal Representatives of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate secretary or registered foreign agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for incorporation, name clearance and registration of the Colombian SAS
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of the grantor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; must be accepted by the Cámara de Comercio for representative acts

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and source-of-funds letter for each transferring UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; additional compliance review by the receiving Colombian bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of articles of association / constitutional deed of any foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; certified Spanish translation required for UBO-piercing analysis

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, shareholders, legal representatives and authorized signatories against OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated sanctions list, UIAF/Colombian national terrorist watchlists, and domestic PEP databases. Because the business scope is ISIC 3040 (defense tactical hardware; High_Risk_Special_License tier) and the payment rails are Government_Direct_Wire and Diplomatic_LC, the Colombia AML framework (Resolución UIAF 164 de 2020 and Circular Básica Jurídica 2022) requires enhanced due diligence: documented source-of-funds verification, negative news review, ongoing transaction monitoring, and annual recertification of UBO data. Defense-sector counterparties must be verified as licensed by the Ministry of National Defense under Decreto 2535 de 1993.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES - Registro Único Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co) operated through the accredited local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá for the Bogotá D.C. seat)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be composed in Spanish using Latin script. Foreign-origin words must be transliterated into Spanish phonetics and recorded in the registry in that Spanish spelling. The name must reflect the corporate type and include the acronym S.A.S. or the full phrase Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada. Prohibited: names producing homonimia (grammatical or phonetic similarity) with an existing registered entity, misleading denomination regarding the liability type of the entity, or names that imply official state origin. Initials-only denominations, trademarked names without authorization, and names requiring Spanish diacritical marks are subject to rejection under Código de Comercio arts. 33, 37 and 39; Ley 1258 de 2008 art. 5; and Decreto 1074 de 2015 art. 2.2.1.3.1.2.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection by the Cámara de Comercio on grounds of homonimia, similarity, or a prohibited/sensitive token, the incorporator may file a reconsideration petition (recurso de reposición) before the same Chamber within ten (10) business days of the rejection notice. If the reconsideration is denied, a subsidiary petition (recurso de apelación) may be filed with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within five (5) business days. In parallel, the applicant may submit an amended name application through RUES by requesting a new homonymy certificate; no statutory penalty applies to a second application. The thirty-day reservation may be renewed by refiling before expiration during the incorporation period. Procedural basis: Código de Comercio arts. 33, 36, 39; Decreto 1074 de 2015 arts. 2.2.1.3.1.1 to 2.2.1.3.1.10; Ley 1258 de 2008 art. 5.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or serviced office address is permissible for the administrative domicilio social of a Colombian S.A.S., provided it is a physically accessible real address located in the municipality of the registered seat, displayed on the entity's letterhead and web presence, and verifiable by the Cámara de Comercio or DIAN. A post-office box or mail-forwarding address alone is legally invalid. For an ISIC 3040 manufacturer, the defense-tactical hardware licence (Decreto 2535 de 1993 and Decreto 1070 de 2015) additionally requires an identified physical manufacturing site within Colombian territory; the serviced office may serve only as the commercial and legal seat, never as the production plant.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High for this sector (estimated 85-95%). The Ministry of National Defense (Dirección de Control de Armas, Municiones y Explosivos - DICAE) and INDUMIL routinely perform on-site verification of licensed manufacturers before license issuance and throughout the license term. DIAN and the Cámara de Comercio may also conduct unannounced physical inspections of the registered office to confirm commercial substance. For the administrative/virtual office seat the inspection risk is approximately 25%; for the manufacturing establishment it is near-certain upon licence activation.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance / homonymy certificate at Cámara de Comercio through RUES
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (or local chamber)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory RUES tariff; approximate COP 18,000 (USD 5) per name search certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SAS pre-registration and initial commercial registration (matrícula mercantil) with RUES digital form, including zero or minimal capital declaration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee schedule under Decreto 1074 de 2015; minimum current fee approximately COP 40,000 (USD 12)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the private incorporation deed and appointment of legal representative (Ley 1258 de 2008 allows private written document)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) in the chosen registered seat
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed notarial tariff (approximately COP 70,000, USD 20) for a standard single-instrument notarization without real-property contributions

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Beneficiario Final (UBO) collection and filing through RUES Formulario B and UIAF RBF module
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Nominal e-administration service fee; statutory requirement of Resolución UIAF 164 de 2020 and Decreto 830 de 2021

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization bundle for five foreign-origin corporate documents (good standing certificate, UBO passports, incumbency, power of attorney, bank reference letter)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign secretaries of state / designated competent apostille authorities / Colombian consulates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Public tariff; approximate USD 20 per apostille in the U.S. and comparable Colombian consular fees of USD 30-60 per document for non-Hague states

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of the full apostilled/legalized foreign document package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered sworn translator in Colombia (Ministry of Justice registry)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark of USD 30-50 per page; approximately five pages of dense corporate and identity documentation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and commercial substance service (verifiable serviced address in Bogotá D.C. with mail handling, annual term)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Bogotá market rate of COP 1.5-2.0 million (USD 400-500) per year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscription plus initial AML/KYC file preparation for UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Screening platform vendor (e.g., World-Check/Refinitiv, OFAC automation tools)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark one-time set-up for high-risk defense tier; includes OFAC/UN/EU list screening and negative news repository

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-license advisory to the Ministry of National Defense (DICAE) for manufacture of armored tactical vehicles; preparation of the material-de-guerra authorization package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of National Defense (Dirección de Control de Armas, Municiones y Explosivos) with external defense counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No official statutory fee is charged at filing under Decreto 2535 de 1993; the cost reflects specialized defense-law counsel and technical dossier preparation, prevailing market benchmark

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Counsel fees for SAS incorporation, UBO piercing analysis, name-clearance handling, and execution of incorporation minutes
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed retainer benchmark for international defense-contractor formation under Ley 1258 de 2008, including UBO verification and compliance advisories

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Colombia Commercial Code (Código de Comercio), Articles 373-381; Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 1-50; Superintendencia de Sociedades Circulars
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Bogotá Chamber of Commerce) with registration through the Single Business Registry (Registro Único Empresarial) and final filing to the Superintendencia de Sociedades
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (Private Incorporation Instrument) and Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital for S.A.S. incorporation; shareholders may establish nominal capital of COP 1 (one Colombian peso) in the incorporation instrument, but to secure foreign investor banking and operational license readiness a minimum capital contribution of COP 400,000,000 (approx. USD 100,000) must be paid into a Colombian financial institution's separate equity escrow/prepaid capital account prior to obtaining the industrial license; funds are released to the company's operating account upon issuance of the certificate of existence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At a duly convened first meeting of shareholders and board of directors of the S.A.S., held telematically, the following resolutions were adopted by unanimous vote: (i) approve the incorporation instrument and the assignment of all subscribed shares to the founding shareholders; (ii) adopt the registered address at the legal representative's office in Bogotá and authorize registration with the Bogotá Chamber of Commerce; (iii) appoint the sole administrator or board members and the legal representative; (iv) ratify the opening of the corporate bank account and the deposit of paid-up capital into escrow; (v) approve the dispositive resolution authorizing all licensing, environmental, and defense-related filings required for the manufacture of military tactical vehicles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute the S.A.S. Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) in Bogotá; Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation document (Documento Privado de Constitución) in Spanish, including company name, domicile, corporate purpose limited to manufacture of armored security vehicles, capital subscription and payment terms, duration, and approximate number of branches. Have the instrument notarially authenticated (autenticación de contenido) by a Colombian notary. Foreign shareholders must present valid passports, and any corporate shareholder must provide apostilled and translated constitutional documents. Execute signatures physically or through electronic signature channel accepted by the Chamber. PRE-RUV Stage - Do not file before obtaining anti-money laundering and background clearance where defence industry shareholder is flagged.
required_dossiers: Pre-validated company name certificate (Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
Private incorporation instrument in Spanish, notarized
Passport copies of all subscribing shareholders
Apostilled and Spanish-translated constitutional documents of any corporate shareholder
Power of attorney for foreign shareholders (if applicable)
RUT (Registro Único Tributario) application draft
Pattern of signature card for legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber rejects filing due to lack of notarization or corporate purpose ambiguity, cure by submitting a correctivo (amendment) to the incorporation instrument with notarization and re-file through the RUV portal within 5 business days; if refused due to name conflict, obtain a new name certificate and file within 48 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Incorporation with the Single Business Registry (RUV)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (Registro Único Empresarial, RUV)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Cámara de Comercio virtual portal (ventanilla virtual), submit the notarized incorporation instrument and auxiliary forms. Pay the registration fee via PSE or bank deposit. The Chamber assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Process includes electronic certification of the legal representative. The certificate of existence and legal representation (Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal) is issued once the registration is complete. Ensure the corporate purpose includes manufacturing, assembling, retrofitting and selling armored security personnel transport vehicles. The registration must include the industrial use code ISIC 3040.
required_dossiers: Completed RUV registration form (Formulario Único de Registro)
Notarized private incorporation instrument
Name certificate (Paz y Salvo de Homónimos)
Payment receipt for registration fee
Document verifying payment of paid-up capital into Colombian bank account or escrow
Identification documents of legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a correction requirement (requerimiento), submit the missing document digitally through the RUV portal within 10 business days; if the NIT is delayed due to tax authority database issues, request inter-institutional coordination from DIAN with form 110.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with National Tax and Customs Authority (DIAN) and Acquire Tax ID
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Chamber registration, navigate to DIAN's Muisca system (Sistema Misión Corporativa). Complete the RUT registration using the NIT and certificate of existence. Select 'Ingresos y patrimonio' and establish annual income tax, monthly withholding tax, and VAT obligations. Register as a large taxpayer (Gran Contribuyente) if capital or revenue exceeds thresholds; otherwise as ordinary taxpayer. Since the company is in defense manufacturing, flag the business activity under tariff classification 8710 and note the special reporting obligations. Obtain mandatory electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) bearings.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation
NIT assigned by Chamber
Legal representative ID and power of attorney if applicable
Water, utility, or lease agreement evidencing business address in Bogotá
Bank certification of capitalization account
Completed RUT form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If RUT is rejected due to address or activity code discrepancy, correct the certificate in Chamber first and reapply; appeal any DIAN rejection through the 'Recurso de Reconsideración' within 2 months and obtain a provisional RUT for banking while dispute is resolved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with Social Security and Parafiscal Entities; Open Corporate Bank Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Pension and benefits funds (Colpensiones or private funds), ARL Sura/Seguros, SENA and ICBF, plus a commercial bank authorized by the Financial Superintendence
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company as an employer with the integrated social security registration system (Planilla Integrada de Liquidación de Aportes – PILA). Register with an occupational risk administrator (ARL) for workplace accident insurance, a health fund (EPS), pension fund, and a compensation fund. With the RUT and certificate of existence, open a corporate checking account at a bank such as Bancolombia or Banco de Bogotá. The authorized legal representative must sign. The bank will conduct KYC and enhanced due diligence due to the defense/tactical nature. Deposit the paid-up capital or maintain escrow certificate.
required_dossiers: RUT (NIT)
Certificate of existence and legal representation
Legal representative identification
Lease agreement of the registered office
PILA employer registration form
Information on ultimate beneficial owners (shareholders) for KYC
Pro-forma invoices or contracts showing intended defense sales
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank delays account opening due to high-risk defense classification, provide the notarized incorporation instrument, export control compliance manual, and the authorization from Superintendencia de Sociedades if the board resolution mandates license. Switch to a bank with defence industry desk if more than 20 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Beneficial Ownership Report and Submit Superintendence for Subsidiary Recognition (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades via SIIS or online portal; Unidad de Información y Análisis Financiero (UIAF)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Report ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) to the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 15 business days of registration, using the beneficial ownership report mandatory under Law 526 of 1999 and Superintendence Regulation. Also register any foreign parent in the 'Grupo Empresarial' registry if applicable. For defense manufacturing classification, if any director or shareholder is a foreign national or officer of a military procurement entity, perform a UIAF report and AML/CTF check.
required_dossiers: Form of UBO declaration (identifying persons with more than 5% shareholding)
Certificate of existence and legal representation
Registration certificate from the Chamber
Organizational chart if corporate shareholders exist
UIAF notification of suspicious transaction protocols if the company is under AML obligations
Documentation of the source of funds of the paid-up capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If UBO declaration is rejected due to incomplete foreign shareholder identification, provide apostilled corporate registers and submit correction within 5 days; if UIAF flags the company, present a revised AML/CTF compliance manual and appoint a compliance officer before re-filing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Defensa Nacional, Dirección de Industria Militar (DIMIL), and Superintendencia de Vigilancia Privada; joint authorization from the Comando General de las Fuerzas Militares
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Fabricación de Vehículos Blindados de Transporte de Personal de Seguridad y Defensa (Manufacturing License for Armored Security Personnel Transport Vehicles), granted concurrently with 'Registro de Fabricante Militar' and a 'Certificado de Habilitación Industrial del Ministerio de Defensa'.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), plus the District Autonomous Corporation (CAR) for the industrial plant location
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I – Full EIA Study (Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas, EIA, and environmental management plan) because production comprises armored vehicle assembly, painting, welding, surface treatment, and battery/engine testing; the project exceeds 20,000 m² built area and consumptive water use threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial non-domestic wastewater discharges must comply with Decree 3930/2010 and Resolution 631/2015 – maximum total suspended solids 40 mg/L, total hydrocarbons (fats and oils) 10 mg/L, pH 6.0-9.0, COD 150 mg/L; volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions from coating operations ≤ 60 mg/Nm³ under Resolution 909/2008; particulate matter from welding/grinding ≤ 10 mg/Nm³; hazardous waste (paint sludge, solvents, spent lithium batteries and oils) managed under Law 1252/2008 and Decree 4741/2005, with storage maximum 6 months and manifest tracking to authorized environmental service providers.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (Certificado de Bomberos) issued by the Fire Department of Bogotá; structural load certificate by a licensed engineer for welding and machining bays; occupational health and safety clearance 'Certificado de Condiciones de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo' issued by the company's ARL after on-site inspection; municipal land use permit (Uso del Suelo) from the District Planning Office confirming industrial zoning. Given production of military vehicles, the facility must include ballistic materials handling perimeter fencing, CCTV, and restricted-access cages verified by civil defense.

defense_industrial_authorization.competent_authority: Ministerio de Defensa Nacional, Dirección de Industria Militar (DIMIL), and Unidad de Proyección Normativa; coordination with Ministerio de Comercio, Industria y Turismo and the Colombian Institute of Technical Standards (ICONTEC) for homologation of ballistic protection
defense_industrial_authorization.operating_license_title_full: Licencia de Fabricación y Ejecución de Actividades de la Industria Militar para Vehículos Tácticos Blindados
defense_industrial_authorization.statutory_frameworks: Ley 1626 de 2013, Decreto 4141 de 2011 (regulating the manufacture and trade of defense-related goods), and Resolution 2014-0567 of the Ministry of Defense approving the registry of defense producers and commercial traders
additional_clearances: Certificado de Idoneidad Técnica y Seguridad – issued by the Colombian Army or General Command for prototype evaluation
Permiso de Exportación para Material de Guerra – issued by the Ministry of Defense for any export of the tactical vehicles
Registro de la Huella de Carbono – mandatory for industrial facilities with >5,000 COP assets under Minambiente

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), operating via the MUISCA virtual office and the official portal www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing a Colombian Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) must first file incorporation documentation with a notary and register the company with the Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce). Following commercial registration, the legal representative must obtain a provisional NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) and then complete definitive registration through DIAN's MUISCA/RUT platform, obtaining the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). The RUT confirms the entity's tax identification, legal status, address, and obligations as an IVA-responsible person and taxpayer. No permanent bank account, hiring process, invoice issuance, or customs activity may lawfully commence before the definitive NIT/RUT is issued.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No pass-through or check-the-box election exists under Colombian law. An S.A.S. is inherently a limited liability commercial company taxed at the entity level on its worldwide income; shareholders do not elect entity classification. Hybrid mismatch treatment is governed only by hard-coded provisions in the Estatuto Tributario and Double Taxation Agreements, and no affirmative domestic election can re-characterize the S.A.S. for tax purposes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (IVA) under Colombian Estatuto Tributario (Articles 420 et seq.), implementing Decree 1798 of 2017 and related DIAN regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No numeric general-purpose turnover threshold: any entity carrying out commercial activities in Colombian territory must register for IVA and obtain RUT from the first transaction. An optional simplified taxation regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) is available to eligible small businesses with previous-year gross income at or below COP 3,500 million, subject to excluded-activity exceptions; defense hardware manufacturing generally requires full, general-regime IVA registration due to licensing and customs controls.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All IVA-responsible taxpayers, including export-oriented SAS entities, must issue electronic sales invoices (facturas electrónicas) through software validated and authorized by DIAN. Each invoice must be transmitted to DIAN's web-service API in real time before circulation; DIAN performs structural, semantic, and integrity validation, then issues a unique CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and returns an 'Autorizado' status. Without this real-time clearance and CUFE, the invoice has no fiscal validity. Export invoices must comply with the same real-time transmission requirement, structured under the 'Exportación' typology.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods, including military tactical vehicles, qualify for a 0% IVA rate under Article 481 of the Estatuto Tributario where (a) the seller is the documented exporter, (b) the goods are physically removed from Colombian customs territory, (c) the export declaration is duly filed with DIAN, and (d) the transaction is supported by foreign-sourced demand, shipping, and receivable documentation. For services, zero-rating applies only where the service qualifies as an 'exported service' under Decree 1798 of 2017, including the recipient being a foreign entity without established economic presence in Colombia and the value arising abroad. Zero-rating does not 'exempt' the seller; it guarantees a refundable input-IVA balance (saldo a favor) for VAT paid on purchases.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) duly submitted through DIAN's customs system and accepted by the national customs authority
Bill of Lading (B/L) or multimodal transport document, or Air Waybill where air freight is used, evidencing physical dispatch from Colombian territory

Inward Remittance Certificate (Comprobante de liquidación y transferencia de divisas) issued by a Colombian financial institution, evidencing actual foreign-currency collection through the regulated foreign-exchange market
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may retrospectively reverse a zero-rating claim where documentation is incomplete, false, or economically fictitious. The exporter is then assessed for the uncollected 19% IVA on the gross export value, loses the right to input-VAT credits, and is subject to default interest and penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded. The statute of limitations is generally five years, but is extended where the RUT has not been properly maintained. Criminal tax evasion liability applies under Colombian law, with imprisonment typically ranging from four to nine years, and is aggravated for organized schemes involving false export declarations, forged bills of lading, or sham remittance certificates.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) jointly with the Comité de Cambios (Foreign Exchange Committee) through Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83; enforcement of the FX regime is executed by the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a managed float with unrestricted current-account convertibility for bona fide trade in goods and services. Capital-account transactions are broadly permitted but must be channeled exclusively through the 'mercado cambiario' (the FX market) via authorized intermediaries. Profit remittance is permitted post-tax, subject to the investor's registration in the 'Registro de Inversiones Internacionales' (FDI Registration) filed with Banco de la República on Formulario 3 (Declaración de Cambio). Remittances attract a 10% dividend withholding tax on top of the 35% corporate income tax, and the 4x1000 financial transactions tax (GMF) applies unless a Decreto 2116/2014 exemption is obtained. The key practical hurdle: an unregistered foreign investment renders capital repatriation illegal and exposes the entity to penalties under Law 9 of 1991; therefore FDI registration must precede or accompany every inbound capital wire.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds of goods must be 'canalizadas' (routed through the official FX market) within 6 months of the shipment date as per Circular DCIN-83, Capítulo 1. Mandatory conversion ratio into COP is 0%: proceeds may be sold for pesos, maintained in a foreign-currency account with an authorized local intermediary, or held offshore in a 'cuenta de compensación' registered with Banco de la República. In all cases a 'Declaración de Cambio' Formulario 1 (Export Declaration) must be filed through the intermediary; non-channeling triggers fines, loss of tax deductibility, and enhanced scrutiny in defense-sector contracts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Channeling Account (COP/USD current account for capital-injection routing and Formulario 3 filings) + Operational COP Current Account
Operational COP Current Account + Foreign-Currency Deposit Account for export proceeds
Operational COP Current Account with enhanced due diligence; can hold USD export proceeds
Operational Account, but global BBVA weapons-exclusion policies materially restrict defense-sector onboarding
Operational Account; Scotiabank global arms policy effectively blocks armored-vehicle manufacturers
Operational Account; Itaú Unibanco global environmental and social risk policy disqualifies military equipment producers

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low, effectively non-viable as the primary treasury rail. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Mercury, Airwallex, Payoneer) are not authorized 'intermediarios del mercado cambiario' under Circular DCIN-83; routing FDI or export proceeds through them breaches the mandatory channeling requirement, voids the Formulario 3 and Formulario 1 filings, and exposes the S.A.S. to DIAN penalties and blocked repatriation. Additionally, all major global EMIs categorically prohibit defense/military-equipment manufacturers under their acceptable-use policies. EMIs may be used only for minor non-operational expenses; the compliance backbone must remain with Colombian authorized intermediaries.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory requirement for physical board attendance exists: the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (Circular Básica Jurídica, Parte I, Título IV) allows reliable non-face-to-face identification via video KYC. However, in this high-risk defense sector, the bank's SARLAFT/SIPLA enhanced-due-diligence units will mandate a live compliance interview (remote video is accepted by Bancolombia and Banco de Bogotá) with the legal representative and each UBO, plus a notarized and apostilled power of attorney for the local authorized signatory. Fully drop-off, no-interview opening is not attainable for an ISIC 3040 manufacturer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: ISIC 3040 armored-vehicle manufacturing is classified as 'material de guerra'; the bank requires proof of statutory authorization to produce and export military goods.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ministry of Defense production authorization under Decree 2535 of 1993 and Law 1119 of 2006; inter-institutional import/export approval (CILEM - Comité Interinstitucional de Importación y Exportación de Material de Guerra); the end-user certificate from the destination country; import permit of the foreign government; corporate compliance manual aligned to SARLAFT and the FATE (tax transparency) rules.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: opaque UBO chain or foreign parent structure without transparent ultimate ownership disclosure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: DIAN Beneficiario Final (UBO) registration certificate under Resolución 164 de 2021; full organizational chart with percentage holdings through every tier; certified copies of passports/IDs of all UBOs; source-of-wealth statement backed by audited financial statements of the ultimate investor; negative PEP report from an accredited screening provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: sanctions/OFAC embargo risk on the final government end-user or diplomatic mission; risk of transshipment or re-export to restricted parties (Russia, Iran, Venezuela, etc.).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal opinion confirming compliance with UN, OFAC, EU, and Colombian restricted-party lists; original end-user certificate naming the final military or diplomatic recipient; non-re-export warranty letter; copy of the export license issued by CILEM; Incoterms and transport routing showing no touchpoint in sanctioned jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: inbound capital injection from a related foreign investor flagged as 'unclear source of funds', especially if the investor is in a low-tax or soft-currency jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate resolution approving the capital contribution; the investor's audited financial statements for the last two years; bank reference letter from the investor's principal bank; sworn statement of source of funds ('origen de fondos'); pre-completed Formulario 3 (Declaración de Cambio for foreign investment) proving the wire will be channeled through the Colombian authorized intermediary; proof of FDI registration (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales) once the transaction is executed.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity contributions for the S.A.S. must be wired via SWIFT MT103 to the authorized intermediary's correspondent account, referencing the shareholder capital contribution and the taxpayer NIT. The bank files the 'Formulario de Declaración de Cambio por Canalización de Inversión Internacional' (Formulario 3) using concept code 4010 (capital contributions for incorporation and capitalisation of companies). Wires may arrive in COP or USD; if USD, conversion occurs immediately at the prevailing market rate into the operating COP account. For shareholder loans, concept code 4100 (external credit) is used and must be registered at the central bank; the GMF 4x1000 exemption under Decreto 2116/2014 applies to such registered external-credit disbursements. Transfer instruction should include: 'FDI COD 4010 - Registro de Inversiones Internacionales - NIT [SAS tax ID]' and must match the shareholder resolution and CILEM/defense compliance dossier if the capital is linked to defense contracts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements follow three rails: (i) SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments with Colombian purpose codes (e.g., A0001 for import of goods) matched against the underlying Declaración de Importación; (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit (documentary) governed by UCP 600 for large chassis, ballistic-steel, and surveillance-component purchases—with the issuing bank's confirmation if the exporter requires it; and (iii) local COP wires via the ACH (CUD) system for domestic operating costs, each debit subject to GMF 4x1000 unless exempt. Inbound export proceeds from foreign government or diplomatic buyers arrive via MT103 or confirmed LC; the export contract, commercial invoice under HS 8710, CILEM export permit, and end-user certificate must all be attached to the Formulario 1 (export FX declaration) filed with the local intermediary. Diplomatic LC settlements are accepted, but the local negotiating bank will demand a complete set of transport documents plus the end-user and non-re-export certificates before negotiating the drawing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDF) on USD/COP, settled in COP, the dominant hedging product in the Colombian interbank market
Deliverable USD/COP forwards and forward-settled spot contracts with authorized intermediaries
Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP FX swaps and interest-rate-linked cross-currency swaps)
Vanilla USD/COP foreign-exchange options (puts and calls)
For export proceeds: forward sale of USD against COP booked with the same authorized intermediary and reported as a 'cobertura cambiaria' to Banco de la República

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal of Commercial Registration (Renovación de Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered business address (e.g., Bogotá, Medellín); official request through the Single Registry of Businesses and Establishments (RUES) portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31 for fiscal year ending the previous December 31; the Chamber of Commerce renewal tariff is a variable fee based on net assets disclosed by the company, with no flat official amount
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a surcharge of 10% of the applicable fee for the first month of delay plus 2% for every additional month, capped at 200% of the fee. Continued non-renewal for at least five years may lead to cancellation of the commercial registration by the Chamber, after which the company cannot operate legally or contract with public institutions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and Registration of Annual Financial Statements (Aprobación y Registro de Estados Financieros); Ordinary Shareholders’ Meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Asamblea de Accionistas (recorded in the company’s minute book); subsequent registration with the Cámara de Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The ordinary shareholders’ meeting must be held by March 31 of each calendar year; the approved financial statements and supporting minutes must be filed at the Chamber of Commerce within thirty (30) days after approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to convene the meeting and approve the financial statements by the March 31 deadline exposes the legal representative and directors to fines by the Superintendencia de Sociedades (up to 200 current monthly minimum wages) and may block valid tax return filing, dividend distribution, and participation in public procurement.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficiary Information Report (Informe de Beneficiarios Finales) to the National Tax and Customs Directorate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); submission through DIAN’s electronic transactional system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar year-end December 31; annual report due no later than July 31 of the following year. Any share transfer or change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be reported within fifteen (15) business days after the respective transaction.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or filing inaccurate or incomplete data can trigger DIAN fines under Law 1819/2016, generally up to COP 9,300,000 per infraction plus repeated noncompliance surcharges; incomplete filings may also impede the company’s tax clearances and cross-border payments.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Colombian SAS must appoint a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) if (i) gross assets as of the fiscal-year close exceed 5,000 times the monthly legal minimum wage (approximately COP 7,117,500,000 in 2025, roughly USD 1.9 million); (ii) gross operating income for the preceding fiscal year exceeds 3,000 times the monthly legal minimum wage (approximately COP 4,270,500,000, roughly USD 1.1 million); or (iii) the entity employs more than 50 workers. In addition, statutory audit is mandatory whenever the company is under the oversight of the Superintendencia de Sociedades or when the defense-manufacturing license imposes an independent audit condition.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS as issued by the IASB is applicable to large entities (Grupo 1) in Colombia under Decreto 2420 de 2014, as subsequently amended by Decreto 2496 de 2015. A defense-manufacturing SAS that exceeds the Grupo 1 thresholds must prepare financial statements under full IFRS; smaller entities may use the IFRS for SMEs, in both cases presented in Colombian pesos and compliant with the Código de Comercio and local regulatory instructions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At least annually, the legal representative must execute a final-beneficiary due-diligence review identifying every natural person that directly or indirectly owns or controls the SAS, update the internal shareholder and UBO registers, and present the information to DIAN via the annual beneficially-owned entity report by July 31. Any share transfer or corporate restructuring that alters ownership or control must be reflected in the shareholder register immediately and a new UBO report must be filed with DIAN within 15 business days; the preceding records remain subject to inspection and retention for at least 10 years.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Minute Book of Annual General Shareholders’ Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Minute Book of Board of Directors’ Meetings (Libro de Actas de la Junta Directiva, if a board has been appointed)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $300–$900 per year for typical domiciliation and registered-agent services in Bogotá or Medellín; fees increase for foreign-owned SAS holding structures requiring document translation or ongoing compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $4,000–$15,000 per fiscal year for a statutory financial statement and Revisor Fiscal opinion of a mid-sized manufacturing entity; military-defense sector scoping and full IFRS transition add engagement complexity and raise the fee.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
